data.name: Aura of Enlightenment
data.description: You can create a 30-foot-aura of normal light.  Allies in this aura gain a +2 insight bonus on skill checks.  This counts as a 2nd-level light effect for the purposes of countering or dispelling darkness effects.  You can use this aura for %1 rounds per day.  These rounds do not need to be consecutive.|AuraOfEnlightenmentRounds
